hook: Morgan's career is a direct map of where AI governance is coming from in media and entertainment: she built operational legal structures for emerging digital platforms, streaming, apps, immersive venues, before the AI inflection point arrived, then moved into AI legal strategy at Amazon and NBCUniversal. The frameworks she builds now govern how a company the size of NBCU evaluates, procures, and deploys AI across its entire enterprise.
name: Lasherelle Morgan

quote.text: I now use that experience to shape clear, practical approaches that help teams adopt and scale AI responsibly.

moniker: SVP, Legal AI Innovation at NBCUniversal

timeline.event: Mergers and acquisitions associate, Latham and Watkins
Business affairs, Food Network and HBO
timeline.impact: Enters entertainment legal; supports HBO's early streaming initiatives including groundwork for HBO GO

timeline.event: Viacom and Amazon Audible legal leadership
timeline.impact: Builds and leads content legal teams for streaming and digital platforms

timeline.event: SVP, Business and Legal Affairs, MSG Entertainment
Senior and Director-level counsel at Amazon
timeline.impact: Joins Amazon AI legal committee; leads content legal for Latin America, India, and Japan

timeline.event: SVP, Legal, AI Innovation and Acceleration, NBCUniversal
timeline.impact: Leads enterprise-wide AI legal strategy and governance

quick_facts: SVP, Legal, AI Innovation and Acceleration at NBCUniversal
Previously Director and Associate General Counsel at Amazon, where she served on Amazon's internal AI legal committee
Advised on the creation of MSG Sphere, the world's first large-scale immersive venue
Built the content legal function at Audible supporting its original content expansion

achievements.title: SVP, Legal, AI Innovation and Acceleration, NBCUniversal
achievements.impact: Leads legal strategy for AI initiatives enterprise-wide, including vendor negotiations, policy development, and responsible deployment governance.

achievements.title: Amazon internal AI legal committee
achievements.impact: Served on Amazon's early AI legal committee and participated as a superuser in internal AI pilots, shaping how AI tools were evaluated and adopted across global teams.

achievements.title: Legal architecture for MSG Sphere
achievements.impact: Advised executive leadership on business and legal strategy for the first large-scale venue combining cutting-edge technology with fully immersive experience.

achievements.title: Head of Content Legal, Audible
achievements.impact: Built the content legal team and frameworks that supported Audible's expanding original content business across multiple regions.
